beneficiTitolo: Why choose window tinting and privacy film in Ticino?
beneficiIntro: Our window tinting and privacy film service offers many benefits for the comfort and protection of your spaces. With high-quality solar films we noticeably reduce incoming heat, depending on the glass and its exposure, block the UV rays that fade goods and furnishings and, with safety films, increase the resistance of the glass against impacts and break-ins.

benefici.testo: Anti-heat films reflect much of the sun's heat: cooler rooms in summer and better perceived comfort, depending on the glass and its exposure.
Solar films block up to 99% of UV rays, protecting furniture, floors and displayed goods from sun-related fading.
Frosted window films shield offices, studios and homes from outside view, while keeping natural light and bright interiors.
Window tinting cuts reflections and glare on screens and shop windows, improving visibility and visual comfort in offices and retail spaces.
Safety films reinforce the glass of shops and homes, holding fragments together if it breaks and hindering break-in attempts.
Less incoming heat means less strain on air conditioning: window films help keep energy use down during the summer months.

fasi.d: We dive into your needs: we assess the windows to be treated (office, shop, home) and work out together whether you need more thermal comfort, privacy or security.
We prepare a free, tailor-made quote, choosing the most suitable film (anti-heat, frosted or safety) to make sure every detail lives up to expectations.
Once the project is approved, we apply the films at your premises, with precision and on schedule, with no invasive work and without stopping your business.
When the job is done we make sure everything meets the required quality standards, and we stay on hand for support and maintenance advice.

faq.domanda: What are the benefits of window tinting films?
faq.risposta: Window tinting films offer a range of significant benefits: they noticeably reduce indoor heat, depending on the glass and its exposure, block up to 99% of UV rays, cut glare on screens and glossy surfaces, and protect interiors from sun damage. They also improve energy efficiency and create a more comfortable environment.

faq.domanda: How can solar films help save energy?
faq.risposta: Solar window films help save energy by reducing the amount of heat that enters buildings during the summer months. This means air conditioning systems have to work less to keep rooms cool, which in turn lowers energy costs and CO2 emissions.

faq.domanda: Do tinting films reduce visibility from the inside looking out?
faq.risposta: No, tinting films do not significantly reduce visibility from the inside looking out during the day. They provide improved privacy by preventing people outside from seeing in, while leaving your clear view outward unchanged.

faq.domanda: What types of privacy films are available for offices and shops?
faq.risposta: We offer several types of privacy films, including frosted films, etched-glass films and decorative films. These solutions are ideal for spaces that need privacy without compromising brightness, such as offices, medical studios and shop windows.

faq.domanda: Are safety films really effective for security?
faq.risposta: Yes, safety films are designed to increase the impact resistance of glass, improving the security of commercial and residential spaces. These films can help prevent glass from shattering, making it safer in the event of break-in attempts or accidents.

faq.domanda: What are the benefits of window tinting for shops and showrooms?
faq.risposta: For shops and showrooms, window tinting protects displayed goods from UV-related fading, reduces heat and glare in the window and improves comfort for customers and staff, keeping the quality of the products on display intact.

faq.domanda: Do privacy films completely block visibility from outside?
faq.risposta: Frosted films provide privacy without compromising brightness, letting natural light through while blocking the direct view from outside.
